items.title: Lori Keith Sees Long AI Growth as Anthropic files IPO
items.title_ko: Lori Keith Sees Long AI Growth as Anthropic files IPO
items.summary_ko: Discussing Anthropic’s IPO filing, portfolio manager Lori Keith described AI’s shift from pilot projects toward companies capturing measurable economic value. She said Anthropic’s customer growth signals strong demand: nearly 12,000 customers spend at least $100,000 annually, up from about 950 a year earlier, and more than 1,900 spend at least $1 million.
